requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall allow analysts to add a new goal.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall provide templates for goals, scenarios, P3P statments, EPAL rules and access control policies.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall allow analysts to classify goals.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall allow multiple subject classifications for each goal.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall provide the ability to dynamically add a new classification type of goals to the tool.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall allow the analysts to request a new classification type of goals and also allow the project manager to create that classification type.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall provide the ability to update an existing goal.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall provide the ability to delete a goal.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall provide the ability to automatically propagate associated policy information upon deletion or replacement of a goal.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall maintain traceability links between a goal and the policy from which the goal was derived.

requirements.section: GSM: Goal Specification and Management Module > Functional Requirements
requirements.text: The system shall provide the ability to display the number of occurrences of a goal in a policy, in multiple policies and within a domain.

open_questions: Who should the occurrence counts of a goal be displayed to (the text notes this is important for ACP)?
